response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT M.Name AS MediaTypeName, T.UnitPrice, CAST(T.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(T.Milliseconds, 0) AS BytesPerMs FROM Track T INNER JOIN MediaType M ON M.MediaTypeId = T.MediaTypeId WHERE T.Bytes > 10323804), per_type AS (SELECT MediaTypeName, AVG(UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice, AVG(BytesPerMs) AS AvgBytesPerMs FROM filtered GROUP BY MediaTypeName), overall AS (SELECT AVG(AvgBytesPerMs) AS AvgOfAvgBytesPerMs FROM per_type) SELECT p.MediaTypeName, p.AvgUnitPrice, p.AvgBytesPerMs, p.AvgBytesPerMs / o.AvgOfAvgBytesPerMs AS RelativeToOverall FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.AvgOfAvgBytesPerMs IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: Track.UnitPrice is the list price per track, and the averages are taken over the qualifying tracks in each media type (AVG skips NULLs).
Each track's file-size-to-length ratio is Bytes divided by Milliseconds as a real number; zero-length tracks give NULL via NULLIF and are ignored in the average.
The 'plain average across all the media types' is the mean of the per-media-type averages of the ratio, so each media type counts equally regardless of how many tracks it has.

alternatives.interpretation: The across-media-type average is the plain average of the ratio over all qualifying tracks (track-weighted), not the mean of the per-media-type averages.
alternatives.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT M.Name AS MediaTypeName, T.UnitPrice, CAST(T.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(T.Milliseconds, 0) AS BytesPerMs FROM Track T INNER JOIN MediaType M ON M.MediaTypeId = T.MediaTypeId WHERE T.Bytes > 10323804), per_type AS (SELECT MediaTypeName, AVG(UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice, AVG(BytesPerMs) AS AvgBytesPerMs FROM filtered GROUP BY MediaTypeName), overall AS (SELECT AVG(BytesPerMs) AS AvgBytesPerMsAllTracks FROM filtered) SELECT p.MediaTypeName, p.AvgUnitPrice, p.AvgBytesPerMs, p.AvgBytesPerMs / o.AvgBytesPerMsAllTracks AS RelativeToOverall FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.AvgBytesPerMsAllTracks IS NOT NULL;
